# Burning Springs: Head Hunt Bosses - Group 3

With thanks to SpaceLime

Each Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and their side-kick group follows a similar theme. Side-kicks use weapons, attack styles, or status effects that fit the same flavour as the boss they support.

The list below breaks both bosses and their side-kicks into two parts:

**Weapon and Effect**

Covers everything tied directly to their weapon, including any built-in mod effects.

**Unique Attack**

Covers any additional ability they have on top of what the weapon already does.

**Ragtime Randy**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Jazz" Grand Finale
- Two Shot legendary mod
- Last Shot legendary mod
- Swift legendary mod
- Bleed
 - Applies 10 damage per second for 6 seconds on hit

**Unique Attack**

- Swift-Footed mutation
- AP Cloak
 - Increases the AP cost per shot when a player uses VATS to attack
 - AP cost increases in stages ranging from 50% up to 406%, based on how many stacks of the penalty are active.

**Side-kick group: Out of Tune Musicians (Jazz Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- “Jazz” War Drum
- Anti-Armor legendary mod
- Crippling legendary mod

**Unique Attack**

- Swift-Footed mutation
- War Drum Intimidation
 - Applies a 10-second penalty that increases the AP cost per shot when a player uses VATS to attack

**The Ace**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Pilot" Auto grenade launcher
- Two Shot legendary mod
- Quad legendary mod
- Bonus Damage mod
 - Increases the weapon’s damage by +300%

**Unique Attack**

- None

**Side-kick group: Loyal Wingmen (Pilot Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Pilot" Missile Launcher
- Two Shot legendary mod

**Unique Attack**

- None

**The Chief Researcher**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Vault-Tec" Laser Gun
- Anti-Armor legendary mod
- Bonus Damage mod
 - Increases the weapon’s damage by +300%
- Radiation Damage mod
 - Applies radiation damage over time, dealing 15 rads per second

**Unique Attack**

- Anti-Mutant
 - Damage scales with the player's number of mutations:
 - 1 mutation: x1.1 damage
 - 2 mutations: x1.2 damage
 - 3 mutations: x1.3 damage
 - 4 mutations: x1.4 damage
 - 5 or more mutations: x1.5 damage

**Side-kick group: Science School Dropouts (Vault-Tec Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- None (Feral Ghouls)

**Unique Attack**

- None (Feral Ghouls)

**The Proletariat Punisher**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Communist" Handmade
- Eat The Rich Damage Mod
 - Anti-Armour Effect
 - Deals 30% armour penetration for 12 seconds
 - Cryo Damage
 - Deals 9 cryo damage for 12 seconds

**Unique Attack**

- Anti-Rich
 - Displays the message "You're being targeted because of your wealth!" in the top left of the screen when the effect is applied.
 - Deals x1.2 damage when the player has 1000–4999 caps
 - Deals x1.4 damage when the player has 5000–9999 caps
 - Deals x1.6 damage when the player has 10000–19999 caps
 - Deals x1.8 damage when the player has 20000–29999 caps
 - Deals x2.0 damage when the player has 30000+ caps

**Side-kick group: Aspiring Commie (Commie Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Communist" Handmade
- Eat The Rich Damage Mod
 - Anti-Armour Effect
 - Deals 30% armour penetration for 12 seconds
 - Cryo Damage
 - Deals 9 cryo damage for 12 seconds

**Unique Attack**

- None

**The Space Ranger**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Cryo" Alien Blaster
- Cryo Magazine
- Bonus Damage mod
 - Increases the weapon’s damage by +300%

**Unique Attack**

- Astro Cloak
- Displays the message "Gravity has become weaker here!" in the top left of the screen when the effect is applied.
 - Applies Moon Gravity to all nearby enemies.
 - Reduces fall speed by 65% if the player does not have Bird Bones
 - Increases jump height by 4x if the player does not have Marsupial

**Side-kick group: Lost Astronaut (Astronaut Gang)**

**Weapon and Effect**

- "Cryo" Alien Blaster
- Cryo Magazine
- Bonus Damage mod
 - Increases the weapon’s damage by +300%

**Unique Attack**

- None
